evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix Partis login check

Partis.si has changed login response which caused ConfigureIfOK() to not detect successful logins. Instead of logout link we now check for udata cookie, which is only returned on successful login. Generic error is returned on failed login - same as on website.

Fixes #12558
